text:
zoe_pm: Heads-up: EdgeFabric (HW SI) needs a compact compliance bundle for their cloud marketplace listing. They specified: SOC excerpt, one-page vendor-signed pen attestation, KMS/HSM statement (must mention FIPS/HSM backing), and a notarized attestation that keys are not exported. Deadline Thu EOD.

ben_sec: We can provide a lightweight set but partner asked for a notarized line. We have TrustAssure e-sign attestations; compliance can notarize a short statement.

partner_evan: Yep legal will only accept notarized/dated statements plus vendor pen attestation vendor name + date. They prefer GCS signed URLs (our listing ingest is GCP) and a YAML manifest.

zoe_pm: Ok noted. We'll produce a single tar.gz and individual GCS signed URLs if they want separate files. Who owns redaction?

ben_sec: Security will own redaction. Rules: remove internal hostnames, private IPs, employee PII. SOC excerpt: controls matrix + auditor + date only. Pen attestation: one page, vendor signed, scope summary only (no vuln details).

legal_sam: For notarization we'll accept a short attestation letter we can run through our notary vendor. Wording must be clear: "Redwood does not export customer or partner key material and uses HSM-backed keys (FIPS validated) for service encryption."

evidence_bot: [automated] Evidence intake note: default external signed-url TTL for marketplace fast-track = 24h. Owner required. Tag: marketplace-evidence/v5. Escalate for TTL > 72h to compliance@redwood.com.

zoe_pm: Manifest format partner requests is YAML. Sample I'll include in the tarball root: 
```
artifact: edgefabric_fasttrack_bundle.tar.gz
items:
  - soc_excerpt_redacted.pdf
  - pen_attestation_trustassure.pdf
  - kms_hsm_notarized.txt
owner: zoe_pm
ttl_hours: 24
redaction: "IPs, hostnames, PII removed"
checksum: "sha256:REPLACE"
```

partner_evan: We also need SHA256 for the attestation and notarization files so legal can verify integrity.

ben_sec: Noted. We'll compute SHA256 and place in manifest.checksum. Also we'll include a short human-readable README with contact security@redwood.com and instructions to request extended retention.

zoe_pm: For GCS signed-url I'll produce a signed URL using gcloud: `gcloud alpha storage signed-url gs://redwood-evidence/partners/edgefabric/edgefabric_fasttrack_bundle.tar.gz --duration=24h` (or the equivalent signed URL workflow).

ben_sec: For the KMS/HSM notarized note: include explicit language about FIPS/HSM: "Redwood uses HSM-backed symmetric CMKs in AWS KMS with FIPS-validated HSMs (where applicable) for service-level encryption of model and artifact data. Customer BYOK is supported; Redwood never exports customer key material to partners." Then add a short line confirming notarization process and date field to be filled.

legal_sam: I'll coordinate notarization once we have final language and signature. We can do e-notary, will attach notarization certificate as `kms_hsm_notarized.txt` (one page).

partner_evan: One more ask: can you include the pen-test vendor name + date in attestation? They must see 3rd-party vendor name.

ben_sec: We will include TrustAssure as pen vendor and date 2025-07-02 in the attestation. We'll redact hostnames/IPs.

zoe_pm: Action list: (1) ben_sec draft KMS notarized text + attestation redaction, (2) legal_sam run notarization, (3) zoe_pm assemble YAML manifest and tarball, compute SHA256s, (4) create GCS signed-url TTL=24h and DM to EdgeFabric. Target: deliver by 2025-08-20 17:00 PT.

evidence_bot: [automated] Reminder: add object metadata tag `marketplace-evidence/v5` and owner=zoe_pm. Ensure manifest.yaml is at tarball root.

ben_sec: Drafting attestation now and will post here for redaction review. Includes sample KMS wording + short ascii diagram of key flow.

zoe_pm: Also include brief statement about access logs: "Operational access to Redwood-managed CMKs is controlled via IAM and logged; audit logs retained per policy." Partner often asks that.

partner_evan: Perfect. Please DM the signed URLs when live; legal will verify notarization + hashes and then mark the listing ready.

ben_sec: Posting redacted attestation draft in thread in ~30m for quick sign-off.

zoe_pm: Thanks team. If we need longer TTL I'll escalate to compliance but try to keep 24h for fast-track.

legal_sam: I'll standby for notarization once attestation is final.

evidence_bot: [automated] Final check: manifest must include `checksum` for each top-level artifact and owner metadata. Export the SHA256 sums as plaintext inside README too.

zoe_pm: Will do. I'll ping when presigns are live. :white_check_mark:
